newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested, compared with Friday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings fairly light and current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250-1300 lbs couple lds 71.00 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200 lbs ld low dressing 68.75.
On a carcass basis (weight only), compared to Friday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers not fully established.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250-1300 lbs few 113.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales Holstein - (grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1200 lbs couple lds 113.00.
